name: Fujimiya Rinne
source:
"[i]How impure! I have absolutely ZERO interest in anything lewd![/i]"

A serious, strait-laced class representative with long black hair.
Whenever she witnesses Koiwai Sena's affectionate behavior, she always shouts "Shameless!"
In truth, however, she's a closet romantic who fantasizes about various scenarios with the protagonist.
Convinced that this flirtatious boy needs constant supervision, she's taken it upon herself to personally keep him in line.

Class: Hinamori Academy, Class 2-1
Height: 157cm
Birthday: February 7th
Likes: Snack sticks, starry skies
Dislikes: Eating alone, creatures with many legs
